text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Our hearts are one the same! ♪ We'll run to our goals, and nothing's gonna get in our way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: (The hook is coming! Okay, time to breathe in through the nose and belt it out as loud as I can!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Together we'll run for our dre—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! My time's up already? Do I want to extend my stay? No, thank you. I have a curfew to keep…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! I didn't get to sing the best part of the song!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A heavy sense of disappointment and unfulfillment dampens Kitasan Black's mood after she gets cut off right before the chorus.
